entities.summary: Serhiy Horodnichov is a retired male boxer from Ukraine. He represented his native country at the 1996 Summer Olympics in Atlanta, Georgia, where he was stopped in the first round of the men's light-middleweight division by Cuba's eventual silver medalist Alfredo Duvergel. Serhiy Horodnichov was a athletes & competitors from Feodosiia (b. 1970-01-31, Feodosiia). Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
